control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60, use the line tracker; otherwise call avoidWalls.
In darkness: if line tracker < 90, curve left 15/35; else if line tracker > 95, curve right 35/15; else call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70, check LEFT and RIGHT obstacles; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
If LEFT sees an obstacle, turn right 20°; else if RIGHT sees one, turn left 20°; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left 10/40; otherwise curve right 40/10.
